name: krx
description: Read the Korea Exchange (KRX) Open API from the command line, powered by the krx-openapi CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read the Korea Exchange (KRX) Open API
interface.longDescription: Browse the KRX Open API's services and field schemas offline, or fetch a day's market data (indices, stocks, ETP, bonds, derivatives, commodities, ESG) via the krx-openapi CLI. The fetch needs a free KRX API key in KRX_API_KEY, with each service applied for on the KRX account.
defaultPrompt: List the KRX Open API services
Show the fields of the KOSPI daily-trade endpoint
Fetch the KOSPI index series for 2020-04-14
